v2.auction_core_question: Can private markets continue absorbing duration while monetary policy remains restrictive, without destabilizing the long end?
v2.auction_summary_verdict: HISTORICAL: all three most recent long-duration auctions (10Y Aug 12, 30Y Aug 13, 20Y Aug 19) cleared cleanly pre-repricing, with no tails and supportive-to-neutral post-auction reactions. FORWARD: post-repricing regime validation is PENDING -- the Sept 10Y/20Y/30Y auctions are the first real tests of duration demand under the new, more hawkish front-end configuration.
